metadata.description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. Facts show who checked them and when.

plugins.name: koalafix
plugins.description: Shared team memory and work items for Cursor and the other AI tools your team uses.

plugins.name: koalafix-auto
plugins.description: Makes KoalaFix automatic in Cursor: the team brief and current decisions at session start, recall on each prompt, a warning before the agent edits a file a teammate has checked in on, work in progress started and closed for you. Install it beside the koalafix plugin. Sends the first 2,000 characters of each prompt (keys and tokens taken out; kept 30 days in the search log) and the paths of files it names or the session edits to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and those paths. Needs Node.js 22 or later.
